svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, the same. Mark a 105 x 100 mm rectangle on 3 mm sheet: the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 105 mm edge is the top (level with the top of the arm), the 100 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge at one end is the back (it lines up with the post's back face).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut off the lower front corner: from 25 mm down the front edge to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 25 mm in from the back along the bottom edge. File the cut straight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes 5.5 mm, 12.5 mm below the top edge, 17.5 and 57.5 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes 5.5 mm, 12.5 mm in from the back edge, 45 and 85 mm below

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two plates clamped together. Round the corners about 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one plate flat on each side of the post and arm, top edge level

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the arm top; four M5 bolts through plates and tubes (step 3).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plates match each other hole for hole.
